metadata.title: Platform Time Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for providing governed, reliable, and consistent time as foundational platform infrastructure.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Platform-level time services including clock sources, synchronization, and time correctness mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern establishing time as a governed platform service rather than an implicit operating system feature.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Platform time depends on foundational platform availability, compute, and network capabilities.

metadata.remarks: Platform Time Core defines baseline trust assumptions for time as a critical platform capability. It establishes ownership, scope, and separation of responsibilities between time mechanics, time semantics, and time-based policy enforcement.

components.title: Platform Time Governance
components.description: Establishes time as an intentional, governed platform service with clear accountability boundaries.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or degradation of system behavior due to ungoverned or inconsistent time sources.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Policy-governed infrastructure services with explicit ownership and constraints.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Platform services, including time, are governed by policy and assigned accountability.

components.title: Platform Time Boundary Definition
components.description: Defines trust boundaries between platform time mechanics and higher-level time semantics and enforcement.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: System instability or denial caused by inconsistent or unbounded time assumptions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit separation of infrastructure time provision from time-based policy decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Trust boundaries are defined to prevent implicit reliance on unmanaged time semantics.
